svg.title: Fan-out on write, with a pull path for celebrities
svg.desc: News feed architecture diagram: a user posts, the post service writes to the post store and hands off to a fan-out service, which pushes the post ID into the precomputed feed cache of every follower, while posts from celebrity accounts with millions of followers are skipped and merged in at read time instead.
